$Comment: Every Focus's five steps, from one template: the Focus rows (GeneratorRows/MMOSkillTree/Focus, set Focus, one
row a Focus) times the six step rows below. Each step is Mmo_Focus_<Focus>_<Step> on the Focus's home track
(Track), priced by its tier skeleton (Base Mmo_Mastery_Tier_<Tier>, the one price table, under Mmo_Mastery,
which carries ResetsAs Mastery and the Mastery Trainer's Where), opening at its level in that skill (At).
The steps: Vow (level 30, tier I) is the Focus's face, the pick a player swears (Stance names it as the face);
Path (level 50, tier II) is an either-or of two faces sharing the Node Mmo_Focus_<Focus>_Path, Path_Line (more
of the line) or Path_Guard (resistance, or the Bulwark's longer Guardian's Call); Signature (level 70, tier III)
grants no number, it opens the Focus's signature proc or ability mod; Honed_I (level 90, tier III) and
Honed_II (level 100, tier IV) add to the line. Every step after the Vow names the Vow as its Face, so it counts
only while that Focus is sworn (TrackStances/MMOSkillTree/Mmo_Focus.json). They run in order: each Path face
needs the Vow, the Signature needs either Path face (its Requires: ziggfreedcommon:track_picks_taken over
Mmo_Focus_<Focus>_Path_*, both faces at once, which a Prerequisites list cannot say), Honed_I needs the
Signature and Honed_II needs Honed_I. Owning Honed_II is a finished Focus: the Second Oath quest reads it.
Why the grant lists are keyed by tokens: a row binds only plain values, so one template cannot leave a grant
out or bind it to a weapon for some rows and not others. The template writes each shape of grant list under a
key the rows fill: a weapon's line bound While its weapon counts ({Bound}), an unbound line or one resistance
({Plain}), and a weapon's two resistances ({Pair}). Each step row and the Focus's kind row (Mmo_Focus_Base_*)
turn exactly one of them into Grants and the rest into $Comment, which the game skips, so every step carries
only its real grants and the Signature and the Bulwark's guard face carry none. The same trick writes the
Signature's Requires ({Gate}) and nothing on the other steps.
A pack adds a Focus with one row file in the set (its Focus, Key, Home, Icon and Parent kind row), its three
lang lines and its signature. An owner retunes a Focus's amounts on its row (generator-rows.json) and any one
step by its own id (track-picks.json); a tier's price for every step changes in the tier skeleton's pack file
(an owner entry on a skeleton does not reach the steps written over it). A hand-written TrackPicks file of a
generated id replaces that step. The step ids are saved in every buyer's record and named by the converter
of older saves: never change IdPattern or a step's Step.
